run_summarization_with_h2o: run summarization on articles using a LLaMA model with H2O heavy-hitter token generation for long context
run_summarization_standard: run summarization on articles using a standard LLaMA model without H2O generation enabled
configure_h2o_generation: configure H2O generation by setting the number of heavy hitter tokens and window length parameters
evaluate_rouge_scores: evaluate generated summaries against ground truth using Rouge-1, Rouge-2, and Rouge-L F1 scores
enable_position_rolling: enable position rolling in H2O generation to handle extended context windows beyond standard limits
